part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 75% chance that governments will increasingly leverage AI industrial policy to direct venture capital investment towards strategically important sectors by August 2028.

resolution_criteria.metric: Percentage of new AI venture capital funding allocated to sectors explicitly identified by national industrial strategies

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 75% chance that the US will further consolidate its national AI policy framework, leading to stricter federal oversight of state-level AI initiatives by December 2027.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of new federal AI regulations and preemption laws enacted targeting state-level fragmentation
resolution_criteria.threshold: at least 3 significant pieces of legislation

part1_forecasts.statement: There is an 85% chance that advanced AI chip export controls will evolve to encompass stricter verification for authorized semiconductor locations and enhanced multilateral coordination by April 2031.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of new multilateral agreements on AI technology export controls signed by major AI-producing nations

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 70% chance that global demand for critical physical commodities essential for AI infrastructure will face continued acute supply-demand mismatches and resource grabs by April 2029.

resolution_criteria.metric: Average price volatility index for key AI-related commodities (e.g., rare earths, advanced materials)

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 75% chance that governments will increasingly impose 'quid pro quo' conditions, such as mandatory local investments, on large AI hardware exports to benefit domestic industries by March 2030.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of countries implementing mandatory local investment requirements for large AI hardware imports exceeding $100 million

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 95% chance that the global trend of industrial policy targeting at least one industry will continue to be pervasive, with over 185 nations actively participating by July 2031.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of UN member states actively targeting at least one industry

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 60% chance that leading AI-producing nations will increasingly use case-by-case reviews for high-end AI chips as a tool of geopolitical leverage to secure strategic concessions by January 2029.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of instances where case-by-case chip reviews led to significant geopolitical concessions

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 55% chance that initiatives similar to OpenAI's 'Industrial Policy for the Intelligence Age' will become more common, with over 120 such programs established globally by June 2030.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of AI policy development initiatives launched by leading tech companies with governmental engagement

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 78% chance that the massive growth in AI venture investment will continue, reaching over $600 billion globally by August 2031, largely driven by state-directed funding.

resolution_criteria.metric: Total global venture capital investment in AI

part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 50% chance that the strategic competition for AI dominance will lead to the establishment of at least 5 competing AI technology ecosystems by April 2030.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of distinct AI technology ecosystems with significant market share
